_note: C-15 golden. Illustrative fixture data; blocks are what spine.record_enrichment attaches.

days_to_cash.note: lead + repair + expected days on market (range from the comps' days on market)

max_acquisition.note: highest buy price that clears your $65/h flip target and every hard limit, provided the evidence still outstanding checks out (not a YES yet)

opening_offer.note: 70% of the ask, never above the price ceiling

resale_conservative.note: 5 FACT sold comps (the highest and lowest dropped as outliers; middle 3 used): 25th percentile / median / 75th percentile

resale_likely.note: 5 FACT sold comps (the highest and lowest dropped as outliers; middle 3 used): 25th percentile / median / 75th percentile

resale_optimistic.note: 5 FACT sold comps (the highest and lowest dropped as outliers; middle 3 used): 25th percentile / median / 75th percentile

transport_cost.note: fuel and wear for the trips, plus $27 for towing a trailer

difficulty.note: needs a trailer, within normal range. An economic input (already in the score), never a rejection

fuel_cost.note: fuel at the truck's normal mileage; the towing premium is inside transport_cost

transport_mode.note: classified when the economics were estimated; borrowed trailer: the score already includes $27 and 1 h for it. Cost, not a rejection

trip_hours.note: driving time plus fetching, hooking up and loading the trailer

trip_miles_round_trip.note: pickup trip only (inspect and collect); the buyer meeting is a separate local trip

hold_likely.value: long: likely to hold until March when demand picks up

note.value: Strong spring demand; dealers clear riding mowers in early fall (first week of October) and rarely discount May-September, so October resale is weaker. Dealer new-mower pricing is used as evidence for used-mower demand by inference. [source: Consumer Reports: How to Find the Best Deals on a Riding Lawn Mower; Bob Vila: Best Time to Buy a Lawn Mower]

why: More evidence would settle it: a diagnosed fault.
Economically it works up to $964, once the missing evidence checks out.
5 sold comparables put likely resale near $1,950 (range $1,900 to $2,000).
Asking $700 is $264 below the most you should pay ($964).
Needs a trailer: about $27 and 1 h are already in the score. That is a cost and a confirmation step with the lender, not a reason to skip it.
October is a weak-demand month for this category; expect a longer hold.
